correctness.rationale: Starting from the published trace and determinant, substitution of \(B=B_H\) gives \(\det_H=r(1-p_cX_1)/X_1=rs\widetilde X/X_1-1\). The published high-\(p\) condition \(q>q_1\) is exactly equivalent to \(1>p_cX_1\), so the case split collapses. Differentiating the exact trace gives the stated strictly negative crossing speed. Direct substitution of the paper reparametrization gives \(D=\omega_H^2\). All quantifiers and positivity divisions are justified by \(p>p_c\), \(q>q_c\), \(X_1>0\), and \(B_H>0\).
